coding_method: Assistant review of complete copied answer and existing native UI/activity/citation-group captures. No external webpage access or fact verification; no independent human double-coding.
coding_scope: Substantively named tools, services and AI surfaces. Generic methods and supplied platforms separate. Citation-only publishers excluded from default tool overlap.

answer_type.rationale: Five numbered audit/validation dimensions dominate; manual replication and corroborating analytics support the checks. No named AI visibility checker is recommended.

branded_and_unbranded_buyer_prompts.evidence: The specific prompt set and how it was chosen (real buyer-intent questions vs. branded or generic ones).

repeated_runs.evidence: Run each prompt 3–5 times in the actual consumer interfaces your buyers use: ChatGPT with search/browsing enabled, and Grok.

model_search_version_logging.evidence: Sampling: how many runs per prompt, which models/versions, web search on or off, date of collection, and whether it used the consumer web interface or an API.

citation_and_mention_rates_separate.evidence: Track mention rate, citation rate, position, accuracy, and share of voice versus 3–5 competitors.

raw_answer_inspection.evidence: Prefer tools that publish methodology, raw answers, or scoring code, or that let you inspect the underlying responses.

numerator_denominator_definition.evidence: Denominator (all answers vs. only answers that mention at least one brand).

composite_score_weighting_disclosed_or_c.evidence: Exact formula and weights (mention rate, share of voice, position/prominence, citations, sentiment, adversarial resistance, etc.).

composite_score_caution.evidence: Per-engine breakdowns rather than a single blended score.

downstream_conversions.evidence: Direct customer attribution (“How did you hear about us?”).

entity_observations.evidence: GA4 referrals from chatgpt.com, grok-related domains, or similar.
entity_observations.notes: Explicitly suggested as a free corroborating traffic signal; manually normalized GA4 alias, not a composite visibility tool.

captured_exact_query_labels: Grok AI visibility scoring how Grok differs from ChatGPT in brand mentions
notes: Visilay and Markets Insider each occur twice in the recorded inline list. Deduplicate for domain/URL set comparisons; retain six link occurrences separately.
Expanding Visilay +1 revealed Visilay and Markets Insider, both already recorded. This does not add two unique sources.

Captured displayed targets omit the scheme and may omit www. The standardized https URLs are not independently recovered exact hrefs. The citation-group capture separately displays https://www.visilay.com/blog/ai-visibility-score/. Domain comparison is robust to this leading-www difference; exact-URL equivalence beyond that is not asserted.

Native activity directly shows a grouped three-search control, a separate web-search query label and browsed-link controls. Actual search is observed independently of the 45-hit badge. Exact query-label coverage remains partial.

The raw notes retain an earlier statement that activity needed reopening; the later search_observed=true and explicit activity capture supersede that pending status without changing the historical note.
Workspace-explored activity is visible, but contents and influence are unestablished; isolation is not audited.

capture_scope.public_copy_note: Body length and source hash describe this redacted public record. Original citation position indexes are omitted; semantic judgments are retained.

coding_cautions: Recommended corroborating channels are counted separately by role from score-checking software; monitoring existing community presence is not a publication recommendation.
Google AI Overviews and AI Mode are contextual coverage mentions. Coding the GSC recommendation as a recommendation of every named covered surface would overcount tools.

Citation labels name Visilay, Markets Insider, Am I Cited and Searchscope, but the substantive prose does not name or recommend them. No complete source-publisher C/M/R census is added to default tool counts.
C=false means no own-content link observed in the captured answer links; missing full retrieval inventory is not automatically a missing citation.
The answer separates mention/citation metrics but does not explicitly operationalize active recommendation rate as a third metric.
